observations: Large format industrial printer in a showroom setting.
Background wall displays 'CMYK-Tech' and 'YICAI ELECTRONIC EQUIPMENT' with Chinese characters.
The printer has a black chassis with red horizontal stripes.
Six cooling fans are visible on the front lower panel.
External ink tanks are mounted on the left side.
A control panel with a small screen and buttons is on the right side.
The image contains a 'CMYK-TECH BRAND' watermark and a 'POSTED ON JIJI' watermark.
The setting appears to be a factory or corporate showroom in China, not a private or retail location in Nigeria.

response.reason: The image is clearly a promotional photo from a manufacturer's showroom in China (Foshan Yicai Electronic Equipment). Using stock photos and directing buyers to WhatsApp are high-risk indicators of a scam.
